pages.text: Cultivation progress from meditation requires an active method. Right-click a method book and complete its Lingqi Trajectory learning puzzle to activate it. Without a method, meditation does not increase cultivation progress.$(br2)Basic Breathing and Clear Heart are starter methods. Their puzzles always use a simple 5×5 Qi Refining board with extra spare moves; realm gaps and low talent do not add advanced mechanisms.

pages.title: Realm and Comprehension
pages.text: To comprehend a spell or study a method, weigh its realm against your own. For spells, use the required realm; for methods, use the realm of its cultivation limit.$(br2)Equal realms yield a Foundation puzzle. Each major realm above the learner raises the puzzle by one tier. Early, middle, and late stages do not count as major realm gaps.

pages.title: Study Across Realms
pages.text: When the teaching stands above your realm, puzzle tiers follow this order:$(br2)One realm: Golden Core.$(br)Two: Nascent Soul.$(br)Three: Spirit Transformation.$(br)Four: Void Refining.$(br)Five: Body Integration.$(br)Six: Great Ascension.$(br)Seven or more: Tribulation Crossing.$(br2)Teachings below your realm use Qi Refining difficulty. These are the lowest and highest puzzle tiers.

pages.title: A Golden Core Example
pages.text: A Golden Core cultivator studying Golden Core teachings faces a Foundation puzzle. Nascent Soul teachings yield a Golden Core puzzle; Spirit Transformation teachings yield a Nascent Soul puzzle. All realms follow this pattern.$(br2)Puzzle tier governs the board and its mechanisms. Talent and assistance still affect the challenge; the spell keeps its elements. Comprehension difficulty does not replace learning or casting requirements.

$(br)Each method has a cultivation limit. Basic Breathing Method and Clear Heart Method stop giving progress after Foundation Establishment Late.$(br2)Method tiers are: Mortal, Yellow, Mysterious, Earth, Heaven, and Immortal.
$(br)Element methods match spirit roots. A strong match can improve speed, power, and cost. A weak match is usable but weaker. A mismatch is very poor or may fail in later methods.

$(br)Reincarnation True Art: Yin, heaven tier, limit Soul Transformation Late.$(br)This method automatically grants Absorb, a projectile spell that steals cultivation progress from lower-level players.

$(br)Heaven Devouring Demon Art: Yin, heaven tier, limit Soul Transformation Late.$(br)This method automatically grants Devour Heaven, which consumes blocks and slain life into fast cultivation progress.
$(br)Void Breaking Art: wind, earth tier, limit Golden Core Late.$(br)Automatically grants Wind Pressure, a toggle spell that lets punches carve blocks in an air cone.
$(br)Evergreen Art: water/earth, earth tier, limit Golden Core Late.$(br)Passively grows nearby plants without creating tall grass.

$(br)Heaven Burning Life Renewal Art: fire, earth tier, limit Golden Core Late.$(br)First death becomes a 1-minute spectator rebirth state with a fiery trail, then returns to survival with 1 heart. The charge resets at full health.

$(br)Cold Cry Ice-Seizing Art: ice, heaven tier, limit Soul Transformation Late.$(br)Turns qi into extreme cold yin qi. Method proficiency unlocks its personal spells: Minor grants Cold Crystal Lock Claw, Great grants Frost Heaven Cry, and Perfected grants Frost-Shattering Skyglide.
